brand.name: The No Hands Company (TNHC)
brand.tone: Bold, Brutalist, Authoritative, High-End Tech, Stark, Awwwards-Level

rules: Use JetBrains Mono in uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and numbers.
No generic sans-serif (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Keep them distinctive.
Deep void black base (#030303) to symbolize the 'machine' emptiness.
High-contrast white text for authority, truth, and legibility.
Use Accent color (Acid Green #CCFF00) sparingly—only for system-active states, glowing traces, and primary CTAs.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing (Tailwind: p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32)
layouts.grid_protocol: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: The Tetris Grid)
layouts.bento_rules: Mobile: grid-cols-1. Desktop: grid-cols-12. Wide gaps (gap-8). Mix row/col spans to avoid perfect symmetry. Leave breathing room.

surfaces: The 'Tracing Beam': Apply a moving gradient border mask to the 4 Pillars cards.
Grid Borders: Use border-collapse with border-white/10 for the Comparison Table (exposed technical skeleton).
Crystal Glass: Use backdrop-blur-xl with 1px inner stroke for the sticky header.
textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 0.03) across the entire layout to break digital flatness.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line on-load reveal. Elements wrapped in overflow-hidden, animate y from '100%' to 0%. ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion.scroll_animations: Subtle parallax on background images. Manifesto items fade and translate up slightly on scroll.
motion.marquee: Massive outline text (text-8xl) drifting slowly in the background as a 'Kinetic Texture' via react-fast-marquee.

sections_blueprint.name: Header
sections_blueprint.instructions: Crystal Glass surface (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030303]/60 border-b border-white/10). Fixed top. Logo left. Links center. 'Waitlist' button right.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.instructions: Kinetic typography. 'NO HANDS.' in massive Figtree (text-6xl to text-[8vw]). Masked line-by-line reveal. Background: Dark fluid 3D image with a subtle zoom/parallax effect. CTA: 'Enter Nexus'.

sections_blueprint.name: Marquee
sections_blueprint.instructions: Massive text-8xl outline text moving slowly: 'ZERO HUMAN INTERVENTION • AI DEVELOPMENT ENGINE •'. Transparent text with 1px border-white/20 stroke (WebkitTextStroke).

sections_blueprint.name: Manifesto (Chapters)
sections_blueprint.instructions: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) using huge JetBrains Mono. Asymmetric layout with p-24 padding. Text describes the '0 human intervention' philosophy. Integrate the surreal empty room image with bg-black/50 overlay.

sections_blueprint.name: The Cloud OS Kernel
sections_blueprint.instructions: Visual representation of the OS. Central Kernel with nodes radiating out. High density of tech details using mono font. Tracing beam active state on the central kernel.

sections_blueprint.name: Nexus Systems (4 Pillars)
sections_blueprint.instructions: 4 cards representing: A) AI Development, B) Central Auth, C) Modular Apps, D) Federated Sync. Use Tetris Grid layout. Dark cards with border-white/10 and Tracing Beam effect on hover. Use the federated sync node image in one card.

sections_blueprint.name: Comparison Table
sections_blueprint.instructions: Grid Borders styling. Traditional SaaS vs Nexus Systems. Use muted gray text for Traditional, and bright white + glowing Accent color for Nexus rows. Left-aligned, high padding.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.instructions: Massive text 'NEXUS' (text-[10vw]). Very generous padding (py-32). Darkest background. Form input for email capture.

hero_background.description: Dark wavy fluid metallic 3D abstract shape. Perfect for subtle parallax behind the main hero text.

federated_sync_node.description: 3D abstract geometric structure. Use as an accent background in the Federated Node Syncing pillar bento card.

manifesto_empty_room.description: Surreal empty futuristic concrete room. Symbolizes the 'empty hands / zero human' concept in the Manifesto section. Requires bg-black/50 overlay.

component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn/UI for the email capture. Customize to have no rounded corners (rounded-none), sharp edges, 1px border-white/20, bg-transparent.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp rectangular edges. Interaction: Background fills or scales slightly, text color flips to black on accent background.
component_instructions.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) to add a technical yet premium feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by applying a gradient overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion setups.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='waitlist-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are using .js and .jsx, NOT .tsx. Strip all TypeScript types when creating components.
Install the following libraries: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/lenis), react-fast-marquee, @phosphor-icons/react.
Never center-align large blocks of text. Left-align for an editorial/technical feel.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur. Header must have backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent color.
Do not use generic 'Vercel' look. Implement the Tracing Beam border effect on the 4 Pillars cards.
Apply `data-testid` to every link and button.
Hero MUST use kinetic typography (masked line-by-line reveal) wrapped in overflow-hidden.
Add a subtle fixed noise overlay to the root layout for premium texture.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, parallax effects).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-12, p-24).
Missing categories of images? DO NOT use placeholder text. Use provided image URLs.
